Exam Date & Time: 25-Jan-2023 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. (ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING)  
  EXAMINATIONS - JAN/FEB 2023  
  SUBJECT : ECE 2153 - DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN  
  (MAKEUP)  
  DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN [ECE 2153]  
Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Implement the following logic function using (i) 8:1 multiplexer (ii) 2:1 multiplexer.  
  $$F (A, B, C, D) = \sum m (1,3,4,11,12,13,14,15)                                               (4)$$  
  
1B)          Design a combinational circuit to convert the decimal numbers 0,1,4,6,7 and 8 in a 4-bit  
  Excess 3 code input.                                                                     (3)  
  
1C)          Implement the full adder using active low decoder.  
  (3)  
  
2A)          Design a code converter that converts a 8421 BCD code into excess 3 code. The  
  converter has four inputs A, B, C, D and four outputs f1, f2, f3 and f4. Implement the      (4)  
  circuit using 3:8 decoder with active low outputs.  
  
2B)          Derive the characteristic equation of S-R flipflop. Convert S-R flipflop to J-K flipflop.  
  (3)  
  
2C)          Design a mod-6 Asynchronous up-counter using T Flipflops.  
  (3)  
  
3A)          Illustrate the working of 4-bit universal shift register with the help of neat diagram  
  register as per the Table Q3A  
  
  
  (4)  
  
  
3B)          Construct a 2-bit synchronous down counter using T-flip flop.  
  (3)  
  
3C)          Write a structural Verilog code for 8- to-1 multiplexer using 2-to-1 multiplexer.  
  (3)  
  
4A)          Write a sequential Verilog code for 8 to 3 priority encoder.  
  (4)  
  
4B)          Write structural Verilog code for 4-bit binary-to-gray code converter using XOR gate as  
  basic building block.                                                                   (3)  
  
4C)          Write a Verilog code for 3-input XOR gate using 2-input XOR gate as user defined            (3)  
  primitive (UDP).

5A)             Implement a 4-bit SISO register using Xilinx CLB.  
  (4)  
  
$$5B)             Implement F = \sum  m (1,3,5,6) using ACT-1 module.$$  
  (3)  
  
5C)             Implement a BCD to XS-3 code conversion circuit using PROM.  
  (3)  
  
-----End-----
